explanation: The statement is a concrete instance of the library's own `RowSquare` (defined as `SquareOccurs (rowDiagram p) (rowDiagram q)` in OAI/.../Support/RowSquareTools.lean), asserting that the partition with row lengths [6,6,3,3,2,2,1,...,1] occurs in the Specht/universal-tensor-square support of [9,6,6,3,3,1,1,1,1]. Its content (Kronecker/Saxl-table computations) is entirely carried by library-local definitions; grepping Mathlib for `RowSquare`, `SquareOccurs` and `rowDiagram` gives no matches, so there is no Mathlib declaration stating this result (and none from which it could be obtained by instantiation). The proof applies only the library lemma `rowSquare_join` along with the local lemmas `sg1` and `sg14961`.
